danceTeaser.description: Street dance keeps me moving. Here's a small window into that side of me.

about.bio1: I design digital experiences with a focus on clarity, empathy, and craft. My work lives at the intersection of research-driven thinking and visual precision—turning complex problems into interfaces that feel natural.
about.bio2: When I'm not designing, you'll find me on the dance floor. Street dance has taught me rhythm, improvisation, and how to read a room. Those skills translate more than you'd think.
